title: Ananse and the Pot of Wisdom
body: Long ago, Ananse the spider was very clever. One day he saw a pot of wisdom in a village. He wanted it for himself. Ananse thought of a plan. He changed himself into a small insect and crawled into the pot...

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
body: The hare always boasted that he was the fastest animal in the forest. The tortoise, tired of the boasting, challenged him to a race.

title: Why the Sun and Moon Live in the Sky
body: Long ago, the Sun and Water were great friends and lived together on the earth.

title: The Two Friends and the Elephant
body: Two friends were walking through the forest when they saw an elephant approaching.
